name: photo-date-guessing-game
description: A two-player party game where players guess when (Date mode) or where (Location mode) photos were taken. Web, iOS/Android (Capacitor), and macOS (Electron).

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:run:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap run ios
scripts.cap:run:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,green "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.dist:mac:unsigned: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac

extendInfo.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo Guessing Game reads photos you select to play the game.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Photo Guessing Game accesses photos you choose from your Documents folder.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Photo Guessing Game accesses photos you choose from your Desktop folder.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Photo Guessing Game accesses photos you choose from your Downloads folder.
extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: Photo Guessing Game accesses photos you choose from removable volumes.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Photo Guessing Game uses AppleEvents only for system notifications.
